title: braces inside a hidden note are not body braces
note: FOUND 2026-09-03, FIXED the same day. The grammar's note terminal opens with a slash-slash-star, closes with a star-slash and spans LINES. The brace scan behind re-homing read the opener as a plain line comment, so it swallowed only the first line and counted the braces on the rest as real: two notes contributing one brace each made this faulted file balanced BY COINCIDENCE, and every declaration between them was re-homed under the residue of the bad line. Both scanners now follow the lexer.
